summary.intent: Debug and fix a broken staging deployment pipeline after merging release PR #298, then investigate and fix IPNS publish latency and token refresh issues discovered during staging smoke tests.
summary.outcome: Fixed Docker API build (PR #308), release-please title pattern (PR #307), CI drift check scope (PR #310), IPNS fire-and-forget publish (PR #308), and consolidated the web app from three HTTP client paths down to one by removing the duplicate orval react-query generation in favor of @cipherbox/api-client (PR #309). Release-please remains stuck due to historic PRs with unparseable titles; bootstrap-sha fix was in progress at session end.

repo: Staging deployment triggers on tags matching 'v*-staging*', not release tags — there is a manual 'Tag Staging Release' GitHub Actions workflow that runs E2E tests, waits for approval, then creates the staging tag.

release-please uses a pull-request-title-pattern to match merged PRs back to components. The old pattern 'chore: release' lacked '${component}', causing it to abort with 'untagged, merged release PRs' whenever any component config is present.

The web app had two separate orval code-generation configs: packages/api-client (axios-functions mode, for SDK/desktop consumers) and apps/web (react-query mode). The react-query hooks were almost entirely unused — only useHealthControllerCheck was actually called as a hook.
CipherBox API is a zero-knowledge server that never handles plaintext — it stores opaque blobs and proxies IPFS. This is why apps/api has no dependency on @cipherbox/core or @cipherbox/crypto.
The @cipherbox/api-client package is generated from the API's OpenAPI spec via pnpm api:generate and is the typed bridge for non-React consumers.
The someguy sidecar is used for delegated DHT routing for IPNS publishes.
release-please--branches--main branch holds pending release state; deleting it forces a fresh reconstruction from existing tags.

code.finding: IPNS publish awaited delegated routing DHT propagation (10-30s) unnecessarily. DB record is saved first and resolveRecord always prefers DB cache, so DHT publish can be fire-and-forget. Changed to detached promise with trailing .catch() logging.

Dockerfile had a stale COPY for packages/crypto/package.json that apps/api does not depend on. With expanded pnpm workspace package list, this pulled in @cipherbox/core as a transitive dependency that wasn't in the build context, breaking pnpm deploy.

Web app's orval-generated react-query client used raw fetch() with zero 401 handling. Token refresh interceptor only existed on the axios client used during login/vault init, causing unrecoverable 401s after access token expiry (~15min).

Added refreshAccessToken callback, withCredentials, onRefreshFailure, and 401 response interceptor with shared-promise deduplication to ApiClientConfig. createAxiosInstance now applies withCredentials and uses headers.set() for safe AxiosHeaders manipulation.

Download-with-progress path used raw fetch() bypassing the 401 interceptor. Simplified to use ipfsControllerGet from api-client for both paths, removing manual auth headers and refresh logic. File reduced from 131 to 70 lines.

CI drift check was diffing all of packages/api-client/ including instance.ts, tests, and package.json — any non-generated change would incorrectly fail 'Generated API client is out of date'. Should only diff openapi.json, src/generated/, and src/models/.

pull-request-title-pattern was 'chore: release' without '${component}'. With multi-package config, release-please cannot match merged PRs back to components and aborts. Fix: add '${component}' to pattern. Also needs bootstrap-sha to skip unparseable historic PRs.

workflow: release-please bootstrap-sha tells release-please to ignore all history before a specific commit, preventing it from scanning old merged PRs with unparseable titles.
Conventional commit type matters for release-please: 'chore' commits do not trigger a version bump, 'fix' commits trigger a patch bump, 'feat' triggers minor.

When release-please creates component tags but cannot parse the PR title, it enters a stuck state where it perpetually aborts — deleting the release-please--branches--main branch alone is insufficient if old PRs remain unparseable.
Manually created GitHub releases/tags bypass release-please's PR-matching logic for immediate unblocking, but release-please still needs bootstrap-sha to stop scanning old PRs.
axios-mock-adapter is the right tool for testing axios interceptors in vitest; vi.spyOn on axios.create requires beforeEach reset of the cached instance singleton.

friction: release-please title pattern missing '${component}' caused repeated abort loops across multiple release cycles before root cause was identified.
Deleting release-please--branches--main branch did not fix the abort — release-please still scanned historic merged PRs with unparseable titles, requiring bootstrap-sha.
Manual tag creation for v0.25.1 was necessary to unblock staging, adding operational overhead.
The Grafana Cloud free-tier instance hibernation caused a transient 503 during staging deploy, requiring a re-run.

Web app had three separate HTTP client paths (orval fetch mutator, axios login client, hand-written IPFS client) with inconsistent auth handling — auth gap existed undetected until a long batch operation exposed it.
Codecov patch coverage check required an additional test iteration after the fire-and-forget .catch() was added.
Two orval configurations generating from the same OpenAPI spec created maintenance burden and the auth gap.
open_items: React Query cache is not cleared on logout or token refresh failure (clearAllUserStores does not invalidate query cache) — noted as pre-existing gap, not addressed in this session.
release-please bootstrap-sha PR was in progress at session end — needs merge and verification that release-please successfully creates a new release PR.
Tag Staging Release workflow with v0.25.1 was triggered but session ended before confirming successful staging deployment of the IPNS fix.

IPNS batch publishing performance may still have SDK-level inefficiency (noted as possible cause: 'sdk package not handling batches in true batching fashion') — only the server-side fire-and-forget was fixed.
PR #307 (release-please config fix) historic PR parsing issue — bootstrap-sha should resolve, but needs verification after merge.
desktop app and other non-React consumers of @cipherbox/api-client have no token refresh configured — onRefreshFailure callback behavior for SDK consumers is undefined.
